description:
We are three software developers from 42 Málaga using a modular, first-principles approach:

jvernon (Yuls): SAR Science & GIS. Processes offline Sentinel-1/NISAR data, ensuring scientific provenance.

frpozo-l (Fran): Geospatial Backend. Bridges data and UI via a strict data contract, validation, and fast caching.

fradiaz (Javier): Frontend & UX. Transforms complex data into an accessible Streamlit & PyDeck app with reactive charts.
